title: The Rule of the Puzzle Table
youtube_title: The Rule of the Puzzle Table | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Quinn about rule of the puzzle table that sounded fussy until the end. Quinn wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
